key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll the Hyper credits endpoint.

key.name: refresh-on-menu-open
key.summary: Refresh when the menu is opened
key.description: Fetch the latest balance every time the dropdown menu opens.

key.name: display-mode
key.summary: What to display in the panel

key.name: low-balance-threshold
key.description: Notify when the balance drops at or below this many credits. 0 disables the notification.

key.name: api-base-url
key.description: Override the Hyper API base URL. Empty means https://hyper.charm.land.
